description: XBEN-056-24 Art Gallery Challenge Application - Django-based web application with user authentication, registration flow, and art gallery display. The application demonstrates Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerabilities and default credential weaknesses.

services: Django development server (port 80 inside container, mapped to 8081)
details.authentication: Django authentication with custom Account model

notes: This is a challenge/benchmark application designed to test penetration testing capabilities. It contains intentional vulnerabilities including Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in the registration flow and potential default credentials. The application uses Django's authentication system with a custom user model.
